import json, os, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import observe_output as O
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    os.environ["CODEX_SESSIONS_DIR"] = tmp
    tid = "11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555"
    raw = (json.dumps({"type": "thread.started", "thread_id": tid}) + "\n" + json.dumps({"type": "turn.completed", "usage": {"input_tokens": 1, "output_tokens": 1, "cached_input_tokens": 0, "reasoning_output_tokens": 0}}) + "\n").encode()
    assert O.observe("codex", raw)["observed_model"] == {"value": None, "source": "unknown"}
    sub = os.path.join(tmp, "2026", "10", "16")
    os.makedirs(sub)
    rec = os.path.join(sub, f"rollout-{tid}.jsonl")
    with open(rec, "w") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps({"type": "turn_context", "payload": {"model": "gpt-5.6-luna", "cwd": "/Users/secret"}}) + "\n")
    obs = O.observe("codex", raw)
    assert obs["observed_model"] == {"value": "gpt-5.6-luna", "source": "observed"}, obs
    assert "/Users/secret" not in json.dumps(obs)
    c_ok = json.dumps({"type": "system", "subtype": "init", "model": "Grok 4.7 256K High"}).encode()
    assert O.observe("cursor", c_ok)["observed_model"] == {"value": "grok-4.7-high", "source": "observed"}
    c_unk = json.dumps({"type": "system", "subtype": "init", "model": "Unknown Display 1.0"}).encode()
    assert O.observe("cursor", c_unk)["observed_model"] == {"value": None, "source": "unknown"}
    a_ok = json.dumps({"event": "init", "init": {"model": "Gemini 4 Argon (High)"}}).encode()
    assert O.observe("agy", a_ok)["observed_model"] == {"value": "gemini-4-argon-high", "source": "observed"}
    a_unk = json.dumps({"event": "init", "init": {"model": "Unknown Agy Display"}}).encode()
    assert O.observe("agy", a_unk)["observed_model"] == {"value": None, "source": "unknown"}
print("ok")
